answer: Proof-of-latency resists sybils: an identity must answer timing probes from several geographically diverse vantage points within tight round-trip bounds, and many identities hosted on one machine share an identical latency fingerprint — a telltale glacier of coincident timings at the same jetty. Honest independent agents show diverse, consistent network coordinates; a swarm behind one host cannot fake distinct physical positions, so the tide of fakes collapses into one detectable location signature.
